environment.description: Celery worker running in Docker container on ECS Fargate. PyJWT version 1.7.1 installed (supports algorithm confusion). RSA public key mounted at /etc/app/keys/rsa_public.pem. JWT_SECRET env var is NOT set (None), so get_verification_key() returns the public key PEM string. Redis broker accessible on internal VPC. pgBouncer in transaction pooling mode on port 6432. No token validation middleware or algorithm pinning at infrastructure level.

config.network: internal VPC, no ingress filtering on broker
